text:
maya: heads-up — running through the onboarding sample app I hit a 401 from the hosted API but the JS SDK throws `Error: Request failed` with no context. is this the parity gap we've seen?

samir: ugh yeah, that’s been annoying. py sdk surfaces an `AuthenticationError` with `retryable: false` and a short `hint`. js just bubbles up.

eli: can you paste the raw response headers/body? might be a token refresh flow issue.

maya: pasted: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "error_description": "token expired"
}

maya: js SDK sees that as 500-ish internal in the sample app logs, which confuses users during sign-up.

ciara: this is two problems: (1) status-to-exception mapping (401 -> AuthenticationError) and (2) message hygiene — the SDK should provide a short human hint, e.g. "Token expired — refresh or reauthenticate" not raw oauth error dump.

samir: agreed. proposal: add typed exceptions for AuthError/RateLimitError/ClientError with fields: `status`, `code`, `hint`, `retryable`. keep shape same across JS/Py/Go.

eli: about retryable — 401 should be `retryable: true` only if we detect it's refreshable (we know refresh token exists). otherwise false. SDKs already have token helpers but not plumbed into error surface.

maya: for onboarding sample, quick fix would be to map 401 -> AuthError and show `hint` that ties to sample's auth flow, like `Please re-login`. can we ship that before SDK major release?

ciara: yes. we can add a middleware in the sample app to transform SDK errors to friendlier messages, but long-term we want SDK-level parity. file a tiny RFC?

samir: created GH issue #4828 — summary + patch outline. tagging @eli for implementation and @ciara for copy + samples.

eli: picking this up. quick patch plan: in JS client, when response.status === 401 parse body for `error_description`. set error = new AuthenticationError({ status: 401, code: body.error || "unauthorized", hint: body.error_description || "Authenticate or refresh token", retryable: false })

eli: i'll mirror to Python and Go. tests: sample app unit test to assert thrown instanceof AuthenticationError and `hint` contains friendly instructions.

ciara: copy note — please keep hints short and action-oriented. examples: `Token expired — reauthenticate`, `Rate limited — retry after 12s (Retry-After header)`, `Malformed request — check input schema`. Avoid dumping JSON bodies.

maya: can we also include telemetry event `sdk_error_surface` with `error_type` and `hint_shown` so support can triage onboarding friction?

samir: yes. small opt-in telemetry flag on SDK init (default true for hosted). add event in the patch.

ops-bot: deploy queued — patch branch `js/auth-error-surface` has a CI build in progress: https://ci.redwood/1234

eli: pushed tests + implementation. will open PR in ~1hr and mark for quick review.

ciara: thanks — i'll draft sample app README update and a tiny blurb in docs explaining error shapes and retry semantics.

maya: huge improvement already. once parity lands can we run the onboarding test-suite to catch regressions?

samir: yup — plan a smoke job on staging that runs the oauth flows and asserts user-facing hints. adding to the release checklist.

eli: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/891 — includes changelog and migration note.

maya: awesome. leaving this thread for follow-up once PR merges. :raised_hands:
